stackup.method: Z0: Hammerstad-Jensen 1980 microstrip incl. H-J strip-thickness correction (bare, quasi-static), multiplied by the solder-mask correction ratio from a 2-D quasi-static finite-difference field solve (5 um grid, conformal 10 um mask, er_mask estimate). Coplanar GND-pour (GCPW) variant from the same FD solver.

via_model.note: ESTIMATE: H. Johnson, High-Speed Digital Design (1993) sec 7.3 via L=5.08h[ln(4h/d)+1] nH, C=1.41 er T D1/(D2-D1) pF (inch units); D2 assumes 0.3 mm plane clearance
